model.title: To designate the facility of the United States Postal Service located at 14855 South Van Dyke Road in Plainfield, Illinois, as the Staff Sergeant Jose Dueñez Jr. Post Office Building.
model.meta: Homeland Security and Governmental Affairs Committee, Oversight and Government Reform Committee · Rep. Lauren Underwood (D-IL)

summary.text: The bill would rename a U.S. Postal Service facility in Plainfield, Illinois, to honor Staff Sergeant Jose Dueñez Jr.
